notes.content:
HI! NEW UPGRADES!
i fixed small and big bugs, and i added options which you mentioned

i have one small question, i had sell a lot of copies but i have only 35 positive review,
you trusted in my game although it is only an early access version. I really need your help to get more more attention

COULD YOU HELP ME? AND WRITE A REVIEW ABOUT MY GAME?



and here is the list of new upgrades


 Steam Downloads an empty file [FIXED]
 KGB operatives can get stuck when arresting a civilian. As consequence the player is unable to send more KGB operatives. [FIXED]
 comic cloud // speech bubble  for soviets needs. [ADDED]
 new menu for giveaways // menu with ration stamps  --------- image


 cursor icon for sending trucks to collect bodies is distorted when over gravestones [fixed]
 red mark/ build stations problems [FIXED]
 more options in right click menu (station) [ADDED] ---------image
* improved system for events (less bugs);
* more description in rightclick menu (church) [ADDED]
* tip button in 5years plan menu [ADDED]] ---------image

notes.title: Upgrade[1]
notes.content:
hello fellas, this week was very hard for me but I made 4 small updates.
i wanna tell you something what I fixed/added or changed.

Remember if you have any questions or suggestions please write here. 
https://www.reddit.com/r/sovietcity/
Reddit will be moderated (on steam I decided to leave freedom of speech).



vsync added
volume bar in menu
restart game clear value in train station ;
fixed bug - restart game causes first task invalid



new background in game (fixed wide-screen problems)
edited "reach the sky" screen (fixed wide-screen problems)
added/fixed 2 names in building menu - (market, sports field)
added building progress bar;



changed icon (blocks)
added icon in soviet menu and descriptions why they are angry and how terror works



"angry" bars over heads
